result.description: Ecommerce platform (Magento Open Source / Adobe Commerce) for storefronts, catalog, orders, customers, with REST and GraphQL APIs.
result.auth_detail: Self-hosted/PaaS: OAuth 1.0a (HMAC-signed, per-integration consumer key/secret; counts as hmac_signature, not OAuth2), plus admin/customer token endpoints (username/password -> bearer token) and integration access tokens used as bearer. SaaS (Commerce as a Cloud Service): Adobe IMS OAuth server-to-server / user auth issuing bearer access tokens; legacy token generation not supported there.
result.access_detail: No central developer signup. Credentials come from the merchant's own instance: Admin creates an Integration (consumer key/secret, access token) or uses admin/customer token endpoints. Magento Open Source is free to self-host (the developer runs their own store). Adobe Commerce is licensed and SaaS needs an Adobe account/IMS project. End-user connection means each merchant supplies store URL plus credentials. Not verified from fetched docs that Open Source is free (general knowledge).
result.api_notes: REST covers products, orders, customers, carts, inventory, etc. GraphQL covers storefront functionality. The SaaS REST API has a smaller subset of endpoints. Base URL is per-store, so the toolkit needs a base-URL parameter.
result.blocker: Per-merchant instance with no central OAuth2 app registry. Self-hosted auth is OAuth 1.0a/HMAC or token-based, so it needs a custom base URL plus token. SaaS uses IMS. Adobe's official MCP servers are developer/docs tools, not store-data tools. Community MCP servers exist (StackOne, CData, Cequence).

evidence.quote: Administrators and customers are authenticated with login credentials.
In Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service, you must use Adobe Identity Management Service (IMS) to authenticate your requests.
Adobe Commerce provides a wide range of REST API endpoints
Primarily the Cloud Service REST API differs in that it includes a smaller subset of endpoints.
IDE integration for Commerce development tasks, documentation-aware assistance
